purpose: Receipts for the microcosm#968 BHC poverty diagnosis (memo in README.md): the files measured, their digests, the engine, the feed pin and the DWP sources. Outputs are aggregates only; no household rows.

engine.environment: policyengine-uk-data .venv (the evaluation legs' engine); microcosm builds stay locked at 2.98.0

feed.note: the spine-s build and the v20 calibration consumed this feed; the poverty measurements do not read the feed

identity: spine-s.h5 and the v20 microcosm_uk_2024.h5 hold the same 52,846 households in the same order (asserted in measure_968_poverty_audit.py); only household_weight differs, which is what makes the design-versus-calibrated decomposition exact

hbai_sources.title: DWP, Households Below Average Income FYE 1995 to FYE 2024, summary tables (HBAI_summary_results.ods): 1.2b quintile medians, 1.3a-1.6a low-income shares
DWP HBAI FYE 2024 table pack (HBAI_2324_ods_table_pack.zip): chart 2.4 income bands, tables 2.1db, 2.2db, 3.5db, 3.6db, 4.5db, 4.6db
DWP, HBAI series quality and methodology information report FYE 2024 (income definition, individual unit of analysis, absolute line uprating)
DWP, Family Resources Survey 2023/24 methodology tables (ch1-methodology-and-standard-errors.ods): M.6a, M.6b, M.8 benefit receipt against administrative data
ONS, Household disposable income and inequality, FYE 2024 (median £36,700 a year)

outputs.poverty_audit.json: measure_968_poverty_audit.py: concept pair, medians, shape, groups, decile composition, and the spine-s design-versus-v20 decomposition (2024/2025/2026)
outputs.basis_swap.json: measure_968_basis_swap.py: simulated means-tested benefits replaced by FRS-reported amounts, same records, year 2024
outputs.tail_profile.json: measure_968_tail_profile.py: bottom-tail bands and family-type, family-size, work and tenure breakdowns, year 2024
outputs.takeup_probe.json: measure_968_takeup_probe.py: who receives the drawn UC residual at a fixed claimant count (random redraws, poorest-first, richest-first, reporters only, full take-up)
outputs.takeup_direction.json: measure_968_takeup_direction.py: the residual ranked by entitlement size (largest first = DWP's non-take-up pattern) and its opposite
outputs.scorecard_*.json: scorecard_731.py at 2026 with the HBAI-basis block at 2024, one file each

scripts_note: The scripts are copies of the evaluation stack's (uk-candidate-eval, not a public repository); paths inside them are the author's local run trees and HF cache. They run under the policyengine-uk-data .venv with policyengine-uk 2.99.1.
